WebGrid Component

Interactive examples showcasing features and capabilities

v0.1.0
📦

Basic Examples

Core grid features with all editor types. Perfect for getting started and testing functionality.

  • Text, number, date editors
  • Select, combobox, autocomplete
  • Keyboard navigation (navigate mode)
  • Sorting, pagination, striping
  • Tooltips and header info
🎨

Custom Styling NEW

Dynamic cell and row styling based on data values using callbacks and custom CSS injection.

  • cellClassCallback for cell styling
  • rowClassCallback for row styling
  • Rainbow salary visualization
  • Inactive row highlighting
  • customStylesCallback for Shadow DOM
🔀

Sorting & Pagination

Multi-column sorting with Ctrl+Click support and server-side pagination with data request events.

  • Multi-column sorting (Ctrl+Click)
  • Visual priority indicators (▲¹ ▼²)
  • Server-side pagination simulation
  • ondatarequest event
  • totalItems for external paging
🚀

Virtual & Infinite Scroll NEW

Efficiently handle large datasets with virtual scrolling and progressive loading via infinite scroll.

  • Virtual scroll (10,000+ rows)
  • Only renders visible rows
  • Infinite scroll (load more)
  • Auto-enable via threshold
  • Configurable row height & buffer
🔽

Dropdown Features

Advanced dropdown customization with icons, subtitles, custom rendering, and async search.

  • Icons and subtitles
  • Disabled options
  • Custom member callbacks
  • Custom option rendering
  • Async autocomplete search
✏️

Custom Editor & Context Menu

Dialog-based editing with custom editor callback and right-click context menus with dynamic items.

  • Custom editor with commit/cancel
  • Context menu on right-click
  • Dynamic labels and visibility
  • Disabled states and danger styling
  • Icons and dividers
🛠️

Row Toolbar

Floating toolbar with row actions. Add, delete, duplicate, and reorder rows with hover or button triggers.

  • Predefined actions (add, delete, duplicate)
  • Move up/down with connector arrow
  • Multi-row layout with groups
  • Hover, click, or button triggers
  • Custom actions with async support
⌨️

Keyboard Shortcuts NEW

Grid-level keyboard shortcuts for row operations with help overlay showing available shortcuts.

  • Custom key bindings (Delete, Ctrl+D, F2)
  • Modifier key support (Ctrl, Shift, Alt)
  • Help icon with shortcuts overlay
  • Disabled shortcut support
  • Custom help content callback
📋

Context Menu NEW

Right-click context menus with cell and row awareness. Dynamic labels, conditional visibility, and more.

  • Cell-aware context menus
  • Dynamic labels and icons
  • Conditional visibility
  • Disabled states and danger styling
  • Dividers for grouping
📝

Full Editable

Comprehensive editing features with validation, all editor types, and Excel-like navigation.

  • All edit triggers (dblclick, click, navigate, always)
  • Validation with beforeCommitCallback
  • Value transformation
  • Custom JSON editor dialog
  • All editor types in one demo
🖱️

Edit Trigger NEW

Test different edit trigger modes: click, dblclick, navigate. Verify grid.editable inheritance.

  • editTrigger = 'click' mode
  • Single click to edit
  • grid.editable inheritance
  • Column-level editable override
  • Smooth cell-to-cell transitions
